weekly_basket.desc: 4-leg weekly basket: 2 momentum calls + index bracket

patterns: ~90% long calls; puts only as index bracket legs
Triggers at round numbers; strikes 1-4% OTM; same-week to 2-week expiries
No stop-losses (sizes for total loss); sells half at +40-50%
Known failure modes: counter-trend reclaims, campaign persistence through drawdowns, touch-win contracts that expire worthless if held
